import numpy as np

def score_merge_static(distance_matrix, demands, capacity, i_idx, j_idx):
    """Return a 1D array of finite float priority scores (higher = merge earlier)."""
    d0i = distance_matrix[0, i_idx]
    d0j = distance_matrix[0, j_idx]
    dij = distance_matrix[i_idx, j_idx]

    # Global instance scale (coordinate-scale invariant, preserves far-from-depot priority)
    scale = np.mean(distance_matrix[0, 1:])
    scale = scale if scale > 0.0 else 1.0

    # Generalized Clarke-Wright savings parameters
    lam = 1.10
    mu = 0.10

    savings = d0i + d0j - lam * dij + mu * np.abs(d0i - d0j)

    # Mild demand-fill adjustment: prefer pairs whose combined demand fills capacity well
    di = demands[i_idx]
    dj = demands[j_idx]
    combined = di + dj
    # Fraction of capacity filled (clipped to [0,1]); reward fuller merges, penalize overflow
    fill = np.clip(combined / capacity, 0.0, 1.0)
    overflow_pen = np.maximum(combined - capacity, 0.0) / capacity
    demand_adj = 0.05 * fill - 0.20 * overflow_pen

    score = savings / scale + demand_adj
    return np.asarray(score, dtype=np.float64)

    eps = 1e-12

    d0i = distance_matrix[0, i_idx]
    d0j = distance_matrix[0, j_idx]
    dij = distance_matrix[i_idx, j_idx]

    scale = np.mean(distance_matrix[0, 1:])
    scale = scale if scale > 0.0 else 1.0

    dj = demands[j_idx]

    overflow = np.maximum(combined - capacity, 0.0) / capacity

    omega = 0.30
